Hands-on training with real industry connections

Wintec is one of Aotearoa New Zealand's largest tertiary education providers. Based in Hamilton, Waikato, we train around 11,000 ākonga (learners) a year across more than 110 courses, from certificate through to postgraduate and master's level.

From day one, our ākonga work on real industry projects and placements, learning their craft from kaimahi (staff) who are practising experts in their fields.
